body:
Part of #115.

## Why

`stopHook` (`src/hook.js:78`) reads `KB_TASK` and `KB_ATTEMPT`, and `recordSession` (`src/hook.js:55`)
writes `SESSION_FIELDS` (`src/model.js:421` — `session_id`, `transcript_path`, `total_cost_usd`,
`num_turns`, `duration_ms`) onto **that** task's attempt row.

In a track, `KB_TASK` is the **root**. Every node the runner claims inside that session gets nothing:

```
$ hkb show 111 --json | jq '.run.attempts[0] | keys'
["attempt","profile","host","started_at","heartbeat_at","lock_sha","manual",
 "ended_at","outcome","summary","pr","pr_head"]      # no session_id, no transcript_path
```

Answering "what did this node cost" therefore meant finding the session by name in `claude agents
--json`, locating its JSONL by hand and summing usage. That is archaeology, and it is the reason the
board has no per-node story for the engine it recommends for coupled work.

## What

Propagate the session identity to the node attempts claimed during a track session.

- The set is discoverable locally: `hkb claim` records `manual: true` on the node's attempt and
  `recordSession` already writes a marker under `.kanban/sessions/<n>-<k>`. Use that convention rather
  than inventing a second one, and rather than adding an API call.
- Nodes finished earlier in the session get their fields written when the hook finally fires. That is
  fine — a finished attempt is exactly the one a human reopens for a post-mortem, which is why
  `recordSession` already runs whatever the status (`src/hook.js:86-87`).
- `hkb show <node>` should print the same resumable session line for a track node as it does for a
  cold one.

**Do not** make the Stop hook expensive or fallible. `src/hook.js:88-91` deliberately swallows errors
so that recording a session can never cost the nudge — keep that property, and keep the early return
when there is nothing to record.

## Done when

- [ ] After a track run, each node's attempt row carries `session_id` and `transcript_path`.
- [ ] `hkb show <node>` prints a resumable session line for a node run inside a track.
- [ ] A hook invocation with no session fields still writes nothing and still costs one marker check.
- [ ] `node --test test/` passes, with a test covering a root plus two claimed nodes in one session.

## Contract — a sibling depends on this

- **Do not change the `SESSION_FIELDS` list or `sessionUpdate`'s signature** (`src/model.js:421-429`).
  #115's other child reads these same rows and will break if the shape moves.
- Do not touch `src/stats.js` — that file belongs to the sibling.
goal: a track's node attempts carry session_id and transcript_path, like a cold node
title: Session identity reaches the nodes a track claims
